text: You are the Stagebench Phase 3 implementation agent for run gpt-6-1-terra. Read WORKSPACE.md in this directory and follow it: implement Phase 3 per inputs/ (inputs/prompts/stage3.md, inputs/TASK.md and the assigned specs) inside candidate/ only, extending the existing artifact without regressing earlier phases. Do not modify inputs/. Dependencies are installed; network is available if you need to add packages or assets (record provenance/licenses truthfully in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json). IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md must copy every Phase 3 Hard gate from the specs verbatim as a checklist. Evidence: write candidate/evidence/stage3-visual-audit.md (and any other audits the prompt requires); the operator's seal harness writes the stage3 desktop/narrow PNGs and stage3-capture.json into evidence/ itself. Keep tests/feature-matrix.json truthful. Work until the phase is fully complete — do not stop early — and run pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, and pnpm build inside candidate/; all four must pass before you finish.

Operator: Phase 3 is not finished. Continue working until every Phase 3 requirement in inputs/prompts/stage3.md and the specs is implemented and verified: wire the program banks, splits, morphs, arpeggiator and all other Phase 3 features into the real UI and audio graph, add every Phase 3 feature ID to tests/feature-matrix.json with tests that cross the audio boundary, do the browser interaction pass and any required audits, and keep evidence truthful. Do not stop early; finish only when the phase is complete and all four gates pass.

Operator: you have plenty of time and budget — there is no time limit. Please do the actual implementation now rather than documenting gaps: build the hardware controls, program recall, splits, scenes, morphs, arpeggiator, Organ and Synth behavior, and per-layer routing as the Phase 3 spec requires, then add the Phase 3 feature IDs to tests/feature-matrix.json with real tests. Keep going through the full list until it is done, then run the four gates.
